headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a convincing 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs. The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory behind Bryce Miller's 8.0 innings of work with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Trent Grisham, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees due to a right hamstring strain. The Atlanta Braves have also placed Spencer Strider on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have made roster moves, including the Cleveland Guardians, who traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers in a separate trade.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way for the Mariners, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, snapping their winning streak. Gunnar Henderson led the Orioles' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a close game to the Cleveland Guardians, losing 2-3. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Trent Grisham on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Trent Grisham, center fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Trade Debut**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season on June 11, 2026, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations.
